justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/TimestampedObserver.java, src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/ObservableInputStream.java, and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/TimestampedObserverTest.java. The class is small and single-purpose: 111 lines total, 1 constructor, 1 overridden callback (closed), 4 timestamp/duration accessors, 1 boolean state query, and toString. It only records open/close instants for ObservableInputStream observers, and the test file exercises that narrow behavior, so there is no evidence of excess responsibilities or clear decomposition opportunity.
